nodes.label: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
nodes.author: Tianyi Zhou, Dongrui Liu, Leitao Yuan, Jing Shao, Xia Hu
nodes.rationale: Automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation with dual representation (capability and behavior tracks) and versioned lifecycle management.

nodes.label: COLLEAGUE.SKILL System
nodes.rationale: Distills heterogeneous human traces into portable, inspectable, correctable, composable, and governable skill packages with explicit source boundaries, usage limits, and lifecycle operations.

nodes.label: Person-Grounded Skill Artifact
nodes.rationale: Bounded package of selected capabilities, mental models, communication constraints, examples, and usage boundaries grounded in evidence about a person or role; not unrestricted conversational model.

nodes.label: Dual Representation: Capability and Behavior Tracks
nodes.rationale: Work/capability track captures responsibilities, workflows, standards, heuristics; persona track stores bounded behavior constraints, expression preferences, interaction rules, correction records; enables separate invocation.

nodes.label: Colleague Application Preset
nodes.rationale: Primary preset for workplace setting: distills teammate's practices, standards, communication norms into inspectable skill using work traces (docs, reviews, decisions, incidents).

nodes.label: Celebrity/Public-Figure Application Preset
nodes.rationale: Extension for public-source expert distillation: prioritizes first-person works, interviews, documented decisions with explicit evidence requirements and quality checks for mental-model coverage.

nodes.label: Relationship Application Preset
nodes.rationale: Extension for sensitive private domain: represents interaction patterns as local, editable, deletable state with stronger assumptions about consent, retention, access control, and non-public defaults.

hyperedges.label: COLLEAGUE.SKILL Application Presets
hyperedges.rationale: Three domain specializations of shared person-grounded artifact workflow with different evidence scopes, governance requirements, and invocation aliases
